verdicts.reason: A reads clearly from left to right (logo, bottle, headline/sub, CTA) and has room to breathe. But the SOLSTICE wordmark is tiny and floats away from any shared edge, the subcopy is very small and wraps to leave 'sweet.' alone on its own line, and the bottle almost touches the top and bottom edges. B is badly cramped: the bottle is jammed against the headline, 'fizz' runs into the two circles, which are crushed into a muddy blob in the top-right, and the oversized CTA pill competes with the headline and nearly touches the right edge, so nothing has any breathing room.
